## What's Changed
* feat(lint): catch overlapping frames and cut-off boards by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/29


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/compare/v0.7.1...v0.8.0

## What's Changed
* fix(antigravity): heartbeat idle sessions and refresh cache before health check by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/28


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/compare/v0.7.0...v0.7.1

## What's Changed
* feat(export): use the irsim logo as the exported site favicon by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/19
* feat(antigravity): add Antigravity CLI plugin harness and docs by @ox-youssef in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/24
* fix(antigravity): make the /irsim commands call design_canvas at once by @ox-youssef in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/25
* feat(antigravity): auto-reinstall plugin on irsim update and polish install scripts by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/26
* feat(antigravity): add irsim connect and @kafbit/irsim-connectors antigravity installer by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/27

## New Contributors
* @ox-youssef made their first contribution in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/24

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/compare/v0.6.0...v0.7.0

## What's Changed
* feat(canvas): agent-first canvas with one composer, Arrange modal and slimmer menus by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/14
* feat: stacked squares logo, favicon and apple touch icon by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/15
* fix(canvas): lay out boards an agent writes to canvas.json, place new boards in their section, separate sibling sections by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/16
* feat: irsim lint, tolerant canvas reader, .html boards and the irsim-design skill by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/17


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/compare/v0.5.0...v0.6.0

## What's Changed
* feat(canvas): one status dot and no Play on tiny frames by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/1
* fix(canvas): an outdated thumbnail is drawn whole by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/2
* perf(canvas): render thumbnails in parallel, half the CPUs from 2 to 4 by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/7
* feat(canvas): snap frames to other frames and move in steps by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/8
* feat(canvas): touch mode in the Play view by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/9
* chore: release 0.5.0 by @assawalhy in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/11

## New Contributors
* @assawalhy made their first contribution in https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kafbit/irsim/compare/v0.4.0...v0.5.0
